# Archives of Women's Political Communication

> > A comprehensive digital archive preserving and providing access to speeches and public communications by women in American politics, hosted by Iowa State University's Carrie Chapman Catt Center for Women and Politics.

The Archives of Women's Political Communication (AWPC) documents the rhetorical contributions of women political leaders across U.S. history, from 19th-century suffragists like Victoria Woodhull to contemporary senators, representatives, and governors. The collection includes campaign speeches, congressional addresses, commencement talks, and policy statements spanning topics from reproductive rights to healthcare reform.

## About the Archive

- [Archives of Women's Political Communication](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu): Homepage of Iowa State's digital archive of women's political speeches

## Campaign & Electoral Speeches

- [Announcement Speech for Democratic Nomination- Sept. 22, 2003](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/announcement-speech-for-democratic-nomination-sept-22-2003): Carol Moseley Braun's 2003 presidential campaign announcement at Howard
- [Campaign Speech at the Story County Iowa Democrats Soup Supper- Jan. 23, 2016](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/campaign-speech-at-the-story-county-iowa-democrats-soup-supper-jan-23-2016): 2016 Iowa congressional campaign speech at Story County Democrats event
- [Barbara Comstock Victory Speech – Nov. 4, 2014](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/barbara-comstock-victory-speech): Comstock's 2014 congressional victory speech for Virginia's 10th district
- [Concession Speech for 2014 Senate Race – Nov. 4, 2014](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/concession-speech-for-2014-senate-race-nov-4-2014): Alison Grimes' 2014 Kentucky Senate concession to Mitch McConnell
- [Concession speech – Nov. 3, 2008](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/concession-speech-nov-3-2008): Elizabeth Dole's 2008 North Carolina Senate concession to Kay Hagan

## Convention & Party Addresses

- [Address at the 2012 Democratic National Convention – Sept. 4, 2012](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/address-at-the-2012-democratic-national-convention-sept-4-2012): Rep. Allyson Schwartz's DNC speech on Medicare & healthcare policy
- [Ann Marie Buerkle at the Conservative Women's Network- June 10, 2014](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/ann-marie-buerkle-at-the-conservative-womens-network-june-10-2014): Buerkle's 2014 Conservative Women's Network speech on American values

## Policy & Issue Advocacy

- [Abortion Speech – Sept. 10, 1977](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/abortion-speech-sept-10-1977): 1977 speech on abortion rights & reproductive freedom post Roe v. Wade
- [About Domestic Violence – Feb. 2, 2014](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/about-domestic-violence-feb-2-2014): 2014 address on prosecution challenges in domestic violence cases
- [Congress Should Protect Cyberbully Victims – Sept. 30, 2009](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/congress-should-protect-cyberbully-victims-sept-30-2009): Rep. Sanchez's 2009 testimony on Megan Meier Cyberbullying Prevention Act

## Commencement Addresses

- [Boston College Law School Commencement Address – May 27, 2016](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/boston-college-law-school-commencement-address-may-27-2016): 2016 law school graduation address on judicial independence & obstruction
- [Bridgewater State University Commencement Address – May 14, 2016](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/bridgewater-state-university-commencement-address-may-14-2016): Elizabeth Warren's 2016 Bridgewater State graduation speech
- [Brooklyn College Commencement- June 1, 1995](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/brooklyn-college-commencement-june-1-1995): 1995 Brooklyn College graduation speech on public education & diversity
- [Commencement Address at the University of South Carolina – May 8, 2015](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/commencement-address-at-the-university-of-south-carolina-may-8-2015): Gov. Nikki Haley's 2015 University of South Carolina graduation address
- [Commencement Address to the University of Michigan- May 1, 1993](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/commencement-address-to-the-university-of-michigan-may-1-1993): 1993 University of Michigan graduation address on excellence & adversity

## Historical Speeches & Women's Leadership

- [And The Truth Shall Make You Free – Nov. 20, 1871](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/and-the-truth-shall-make-you-free-nov-20-1871): Victoria Woodhull's 1871 defense of free love at Steinway Hall
- [A Woman President: If Not Now, When? – Feb. 7, 2006](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/a-woman-president-if-not-now-when-feb-7-2006): 2006 Dole Institute lecture on women's political leadership & presidency
- [Voices of Leadership – Oct. 18, 2012](https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2017/03/09/barbara-obrien-at-voices-of-leadership-oct-18-2012): Barbara O'Brien's 2012 Denver speech on career change & public policy
